name: Witching Hour
source:
Your new friend has a stalker, and she's asked you to help her in the middle of the night. He comes knocking,  but can you save her? 

[From [url=https://hoi790.itch.io/witching-hour]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的新朋友有跟踪狂，她请求你在半夜帮助她。他来敲门，但你能救她吗？

[来自[url=https://hoi790.itch.io/witching-hour]Itch.io[/url]]
